instruction: Enable automatic cloud synchronization for this document so it saves to Google Drive every time I make changes.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have native automatic cloud synchronization features integrated with Google Drive or other cloud storage services. While users can manually save documents to cloud-synced folders, Writer does not provide built-in automatic cloud sync functionality.
